chapter: Blue Note, The Connection and Tony Williams
title: Leaving Prestige for Blue Note
summary: Alfred Lion and Frank Wolff found McLean at a club and signed him instead of extending his Prestige option.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Was it ’58 or ’59 you got away from Prestige? Were you . . . ?
Were you running as you left?

Yeah, I just wanted to get away from there. Especially I knew that my option – I had an option that I could have signed which would have extended my contract another year, I think. Then Alfred and Frank showed up in a club where I was working. When I came off on the break, Alfred and Frank said, “Jackie, why don’t you come up? Are you still signed with Prestige?” I said, “Not really, man.” So they said, “Why don’t you come up to the office, and let’s talk.” So I said, “You want me to make a recording for Blue Note?” So he said, “Yeah, sign a contract.” So I said, oh, okay. So the next day I went up there. That’s how it started.
